scripts.dev:api: npm run build:api && npm run start --workspace @cloudlane/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @cloudlane/api
scripts.check: npm run build:api && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:ci && npm run check:e2e && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && node tools/contract-generator/generate.mjs --check && python3 scripts/validate_progress.py
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build --workspace @cloudlane/dashboard && node scripts/verify_static.mjs http
scripts.build:preview: npm run build:api && npm run build:preview --workspace @cloudlane/dashboard && node scripts/verify_static.mjs demo
scripts.lint: prettier --check apps packages tools scripts/*.mjs tests playwright.config.ts *.json *.js .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tools scripts/*.mjs tests playwright.config.ts *.json *.js .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.test: npm run build:api && node --test apps/api/test/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.contracts:generate: npm run build:api && node tools/contract-generator/generate.mjs && npm run build:contracts
